How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

Questions to ask the vendor (8)

  1. In what year was Sierra founded and incorporated, and under what legal entity?
    The founding date anchors the vendor's operating history.
  2. How many full-time employees does Sierra have, and how many work in engineering and customer support?
    Headcount indicates capacity to support a large bank deployment.
  3. What is the total equity capital Sierra has raised to date, and what is its current cash runway?
    Total capital raised is an input to judging financial staying power.
  4. Has Sierra reduced its workforce in the last 24 months, and if so by how much and in which teams?
    Workforce reductions can signal financial stress and affect support quality.
  5. Is Sierra party to any material litigation, including privacy or wiretapping claims arising from recorded conversations?
    Material litigation can affect viability and reputation.
  6. Has Sierra had any security incident affecting corporate systems or customer data in the last five years, and how was each disclosed?
    A supplier's security record indicates how safe the bank's customer conversations are.
  7. Has Sierra lost or been replaced at any financial-services customer in the last 24 months, and why?
    Loss of large customers can indicate product or service problems.
  8. Have there been any executive departures, conduct findings or governance disputes at Sierra in the last 24 months?
    Leadership conduct and turnover affect supplier stability.

Timeline

  1. 2026-11-13 · launch Sierra
    Sierra releases version 1.0 of the Personal Agent Protocol

    Sierra published on 2026-11-13 version 1.0 of the Personal Agent Protocol, a specification for how consumers' personal AI agents connect to companies' agents, websites and APIs, together with an implementation kit and validator. Sierra's post says the protocol builds on existing standards including MCP, OpenAPI and OAuth, that design partners now number more than 100, and that Shopify has enabled it for the merchants on its platform. Sierra (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)

  2. 2026-11-05 · acquisition Sierra
    Sierra acquires browser-agent infrastructure company Anon

    Sierra announced that Anon, which built infrastructure for AI agents to sign in to and operate websites that have no API, is joining Sierra. Terms were not disclosed. Sierra said the technology will let its agents work in systems without APIs. Sierra (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  3. 2026-07-16 · launch Sierra
    Sierra introduces Horizon for longer-running agent tasks

    Sierra published a post introducing Horizon on 2026-07-16. Its home page describes Horizon as covering long-horizon planning, customer context, outcome optimisation and proactive engagement, and Horizon has its own service-specific terms. Sierra (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)Sierra (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)Sierra (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  4. 2026-05-04 · funding Sierra
    Sierra raises US$950M at a valuation above US$15B

    Sierra announced a US$950M funding round led by Tiger Global and GV, valuing the company at more than US$15B. SiliconANGLE also named Benchmark, Sequoia and Greenoaks as investors. CMSWire reported that the round took total capital raised above US$1B, following US$350M in September 2025 at a US$10B valuation. SiliconANGLE (independent press, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)CMSWire (independent press, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  5. 2025-11-01 · certification Sierra
    Sierra announces a PCI DSS v4.0.1 attestation of compliance

    Sierra's trust centre announced on 2025-11-01 that the company holds a PCI DSS attestation of compliance. Its product page describes the status as PCI DSS Level 1 Service Provider, with cardholder data handled in separate infrastructure.
